about_the_game:
Plot Summary

Rosina is an investigator with a strong sense of justice. While investigating a missing case, she accidentally fall into the Fallen land. In there, Rosina soon discovers the truth behind the missing people. However, the pathway connecting the two worlds will only open under certain conditions. In addition, the brutal creatures of the fallen land begin to gradually surround her. She must fight and survive until the way home opens again.

Gameplay

This game combines 2D shooting and roguelite elements. The gameplay mainly revolves around how to resist the continuous flow of enemies every day.

With the help of all your companions, combine the power of magic and firearms to defeat all enemies.

Enjoy unstoppable shooting and chaotic situations.
If you survive each battle, There could be new stories and events
If you meet the conditions, There are also H events.

Roguelite -
During the battle, your companion Noah will level up and gain random magic powers of your choice. Alternatively, you can exchange this level for additional materials for upgrading and crafting items.

Items and Weapons -
Materials obtained from enemies can be used to craft items for use in battle or to upgrade weapons.
There are three main weapons and three secondary weapons to choose from.

H Content - Purification (Massage)


In order to prevent Rosina being Mana poisoned, she needs to be purified regularly by Noah. But at the same time, Noah has his own plans.
Use Noah's magic touch to slowly and carefully hypnotize her, and let her corrupted without realizing it.
The more she corrupted, the more parts of her body you can touch. From head to toe, from back to front, many parts of the body can be touched freely.

Cheat Mode

There are two cheat modes: invincible mode and one-hit-kill mode. Only available in story mode.

During the preparation phase, press Ctrl + A + C to activate invincibility mode, and press Ctrl + A + V to activate one-hit kill mode.



When the left candle turns purple, invincibility mode activated.

When the right candle turns purple, one-hit kill mode activated.

  • Please check the input settings in the options first.
  • The game automatically saves every day. Manual saving is only available in the preparation area.
  • If there are no enemies during the battle but it has not ended, press Ctrl + F2 to force the battle to end.
  • This game has no defeat CG / animations
  • No censorship in game.
